backend.app.py: FastAPI composition root: REST/WebSocket routes, service wiring, health endpoint, and Uvicorn launch.
backend.runtime_platform.py: Only backend owner of Windows/Linux runtime paths, executable name, Docker/WSL capabilities, and backend-port override.
backend.settings.py: Thread-safe JSON settings defaults and persistence.
backend.database.py: SQLAlchemy persistence for queue/history and library records.
backend.queue_processor.py: Sequential queue execution and pause/resume control.
backend.wrapper_manager.py: Wrapper container configuration, auth flow, and lifecycle.
backend.docker_manager.py: Docker discovery and Windows-only Desktop startup policy.
backend.setup_manager.py: First-run readiness checks, image/bootstrap flow, and setup state.
backend.library_manager.py: Scans downloaded tracks and exposes library metadata/stream paths.
backend.flac_converter.py: Converts downloaded ALAC audio to FLAC using the managed image.
backend.progress.py: In-memory event broadcasters for progress, setup, auth, wrapper, and logs.
backend.logger.py: Application logging in the platform writable data directory.

frontend.src/main.tsx: Renderer bootstrap; HashRouter is required for packaged file:// routing.
frontend.src/App.tsx: Application shell, routes, initial status refresh, global progress WebSocket.
frontend.src/api/client.ts: Axios client for the local FastAPI service.
frontend.src/store/useAppStore.ts: Shared app status, setup state, queue/download actions.
frontend.src/pages: Download, queue, library, history, logs, settings, home, and about views.
frontend.src/components/SetupWizard.tsx: First-run Docker/images/auth/wrapper setup flow; renders platform-specific Docker/WSL guidance from backend data.

electron.electron/main.js: Main-process lifecycle, backend process controller, BrowserWindow, and safe IPC handlers.
electron.electron/platform.js: Only Electron owner of Windows/Linux executable, dev interpreter, data-path, and icon policy.
electron.electron/backend-process-controller.js: Starts/stops/restarts backend process trees without duplicates.
electron.electron/preload.js: Minimal context-isolated renderer API: open folder, notification, folder picker.
electron.electron/smoke-packaged.js: Launches an unpacked packaged app with a unique port/token and checks its backend health.

delivery.backend/backend.spec: PyInstaller COLLECT build; platform-native executable is named backend.exe on Windows and backend on Linux.
delivery.frontend/package.json: Frontend scripts, electron-builder targets, extraResources backend inclusion.
delivery..github/workflows/release.yml: Tag-driven native Windows/Linux build, test, package, smoke-test, artifact, checksum, and GitHub Release workflow.
delivery.docs/superpowers: Design rationale and implementation plan for the current desktop-release work.

marketing.marketing/app/page.tsx: Static landing-page composition, navigation, product proof, FAQ, evidence, and feedback sections.
marketing.marketing/components/community-proof.tsx: Client leaf for anonymous visit recording, release-download totals, public metrics, and moderated review display.
marketing.marketing/components/feedback-form.tsx: Accessible rating and feedback form; persists a private moderation record and forwards a notification email.
marketing.marketing/lib/public-data.ts: Typed browser API boundary for Supabase RPC calls and GitHub release-asset download totals.
marketing.supabase/migrations/20260908081119_audor: RLS-protected anonymous visitor metrics, private feedback, aggregate evidence, and review-publication contract.
marketing.marketing/tests/funnel.spec.ts: Desktop/mobile funnel, progressive enhancement, evidence, review, and feedback-form browser coverage.

backend/tests: auth, Docker discovery/manager/platform behavior, downloader command/stages/config, FLAC conversion
library/settings/database behaviors, progress, setup/wrapper, diagnostics, utilities
frontend/electron/*.test.js: packaged-backend smoke polling and token isolation
